name: glyhub_GPST000460_N
title: Cardiac N-glycomes in fatal COVID-19
description: N-glycan MS1 peak areas from cardiac tissue and isolated cardiomyocytes of COVID-positive and COVID-negative donors.
details: Four source tables are combined by exact composition-plus-retention labels, normalizing only GU/RRT notation and spacing. The sample metadata distinguishes FFPE tissue from isolated cardiomyocytes and COVID status. Features absent from a source table remain missing rather than zero. Maltodextrin calibration ladders and class summaries are excluded. Published GlyTouCan structures are linked only when composition and retention position identify a unique annotation; inconsistent registry assignments remain unresolved. Clinical metadata uses exact published patient identifiers; abbreviated ambiguous cardiomyocyte IDs are not guessed.
